meta.name: Moonwalk 2024
meta.description:
Moonwalk follows two thieves, Tarik Pandey and Maddy Kapoor, as they go head-to-head to steal the heart of a local heartthrob, Chandini Lakhani. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences and something far more valuable...and out of this world- a piece of rock from the Moon that lands on Earth!

Rated U/A 16+ · Returning Series · First aired 20 Dec 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Jio Studios, Jar Pictures · Network: JioCinema

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Jail Junoon aur Jaaneman
videos.overview: Tarik Pandey, the best thief in Rampur, makes a mistake and lands in jail. His girlfriend Chandni leaves him for Maddy. However, Badan Singh an aging gangster, watches his empire collapse as his son dreams of becoming a professor. Can their fortunes turn around?

videos.title: Gazab ho Gaya
videos.overview: Heartbroken over losing Chandni, Tarik is at his lowest until his legendary cellmate, Ghalib "Ghazab" Khan, offers him a way out to escape prison. He asks Tarik to deliver a ring to Azmat, his daughter. Can Tarik seize his second chance?

videos.title: Get Set Chor
videos.overview: Tarik, joined by his loyal friend Kamal, sets out to win Chandni back but faces Maddy. Chandni puts a bet before the two to steal the better item and her heart will belong to the winner. Meanwhile, an uptight cop arrives in Rampur, hot on Tarik's trail. Can Tarik find a way out?

videos.title: Tod Tayaari
videos.overview: Tarik travels to Moradabad to deliver the ring to Azmat, Ghalib's daughter and discovers the Bahadur Shah Zafar gold commode. He plans to steal it, while Maddy, with Chandni, plots to steal a priceless necklace. Will Tarik succeed in his heist?

videos.title: Dagaa Dawat aur Dacaiti
videos.overview: Tarik outwits Ramesh in the heist of a lifetime. It's a showdown between Maddy and Tarik, Delhi versus Rampur, the golden commode versus the priceless necklace. Can Tarik succeed in pulling off the ultimate heist?

videos.title: Kamal ya Kamaa
videos.overview: Maddy discovers he's stolen a fake necklace, which makes Chandni leave him. Meanwhile, Tarik, Kamal, and Azmat flee to a safe house, as Chappan devises a plan to make his father millions. Can Tarik find a way out of this deadly twist?

videos.title: Aasman se Gira
videos.overview: Maddy escapes with the golden commode to win back Chandni, while Nadra rescues Tarik and Azmat. Meanwhile, Chappan leads his father to a treasure beyond imagination, a moon rock. Is a new Moonwalk heist about to begin?

videos.title: K se Khabar
videos.overview: Tarik and Azmat learn that the Moonrock is worth even more than the golden commode and devise a plan to win Chandni back. However, the commode ends up in Inspector Ramesh's hands, leaving Maddy in jail. Will this make it easier for Tarik?

videos.title: Dil Dushman Dhamaka
videos.overview: Tarik plans to steal the Moonrock from the Excise department warehouse with Azmat's help. Unfortunately, Tarik gets caught, and Maddy fails to steal it, too. To Badan and Chappan's shock, the rock disappears. Who took it?

videos.title: Aakhri Daawat
videos.overview: The hero defeats the villains, wins the heroine, and steals the money reaching the climax. But there's no happy ending, as some of North India's most dangerous goons come for him. Can he escape them?
